name: ctor_syntax_test.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((Point (mk-Point (x Int)(y Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((TestUserDefinedCtor (mk-TestUserDefinedCtor (p Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((TestSeqCtor (mk-TestSeqCtor (s (Seq Int))))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Rectangle (mk-Rectangle (topLeft Ref)(bottomRight Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((TestNestedCtor (mk-TestNestedCtor (r Ref)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-Point (sel-Point Point))
  (lift-TestUserDefinedCtor (sel-TestUserDefinedCtor TestUserDefinedCtor))
  (lift-TestSeqCtor (sel-TestSeqCtor TestSeqCtor))
  (lift-Rectangle (sel-Rectangle Rectangle))
  (lift-TestNestedCtor (sel-TestNestedCtor TestNestedCtor))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-Point ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Point (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Point ((this Ref)) Point
  (sel-Point (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-TestUserDefinedCtor ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TestUserDefinedCtor (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TestUserDefinedCtor ((this Ref)) TestUserDefinedCtor
  (sel-TestUserDefinedCtor (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-TestSeqCtor ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TestSeqCtor (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TestSeqCtor ((this Ref)) TestSeqCtor
  (sel-TestSeqCtor (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Rectangle ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Rectangle (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Rectangle ((this Ref)) Rectangle
  (sel-Rectangle (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-TestNestedCtor ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TestNestedCtor (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TestNestedCtor ((this Ref)) TestNestedCtor
  (sel-TestNestedCtor (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-Point ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Point this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-TestUserDefinedCtor ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TestUserDefinedCtor this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-TestSeqCtor ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TestSeqCtor this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Rectangle ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Rectangle this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-TestNestedCtor ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TestNestedCtor this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class Point:
; ----------------------------

; --- getters for Point.x: ---

(define-fun Point.x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-Point this))
)

; --- getters for Point.y: ---

(define-fun Point.y ((this Ref)) Int
  (y (deref-Point this))
)

; ------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TestUserDefinedCtor:
; ------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TestUserDefinedCtor.p: ---

(define-fun TestUserDefinedCtor!p ((this Ref)) Ref
  (p (deref-TestUserDefinedCtor this))
)

; ----------------------------------
;   Getters for class TestSeqCtor:
; ----------------------------------

; --- getters for TestSeqCtor.s: ---

(define-fun TestSeqCtor!s ((this Ref)) (Seq Int)
  (s (deref-TestSeqCtor this))
)

; --------------------------------
;   Getters for class Rectangle:
; --------------------------------

; --- getters for Rectangle.topLeft: ---

(define-fun Rectangle.topLeft ((this Ref)) Ref
  (topLeft (deref-Rectangle this))
)

(define-fun Rectangle!topLeft ((this Ref)) Ref
  (topLeft (deref-Rectangle this))
)

; --- getters for Rectangle.bottomRight: ---

(define-fun Rectangle.bottomRight ((this Ref)) Ref
  (bottomRight (deref-Rectangle this))
)

(define-fun Rectangle!bottomRight ((this Ref)) Ref
  (bottomRight (deref-Rectangle this))
)

; -------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TestNestedCtor:
; -------------------------------------

; --- getters for TestNestedCtor.r: ---

(define-fun TestNestedCtor!r ((this Ref)) Ref
  (r (deref-TestNestedCtor this))
)

; ========================================
; === Constructor parameter constants: ===
; ========================================

(declare-const const__1 Int)
(declare-const const__2 Int)


; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Point:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-Point Point)
(declare-const const-4-Point Point)
(declare-const const-5-Point Point)



; --------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TestUserDefinedCtor:
; --------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-6-TestUserDefinedCtor TestUserDefinedCtor)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TestUserDefinedCtor.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (deref (TestUserDefinedCtor!p this)) (lift-Point (mk-Point const__1 const__2)))
)

(assert (! (TestUserDefinedCtor.inv1 6) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TestUserDefinedCtor.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Point (TestUserDefinedCtor!p this))
)

(assert (! (TestUserDefinedCtor.inv2 6) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TestUserDefinedCtor.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Point.x (TestUserDefinedCtor!p this)) 10)
)

(assert (! (TestUserDefinedCtor.inv3 6) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TestUserDefinedCtor.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Point.y (TestUserDefinedCtor!p this)) 20)
)

(assert (! (TestUserDefinedCtor.inv4 6) :named _xkassert3))



; ------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TestSeqCtor:
; ------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-7-TestSeqCtor TestSeqCtor)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TestSeqCtor.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TestSeqCtor!s this) (seq.++ (seq.++ (seq.unit 1) (seq.unit 2)) (seq.unit 3)))
)

(assert (! (TestSeqCtor.inv1 7) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TestSeqCtor.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (seq.len (TestSeqCtor!s this)) 3)
)

(assert (! (TestSeqCtor.inv2 7) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TestSeqCtor.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (seq.nth (TestSeqCtor!s this) 0) 1)
)

(assert (! (TestSeqCtor.inv3 7) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TestSeqCtor.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (seq.nth (TestSeqCtor!s this) 1) 2)
)

(assert (! (TestSeqCtor.inv4 7) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TestSeqCtor.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (seq.nth (TestSeqCtor!s this) 2) 3)
)

(assert (! (TestSeqCtor.inv5 7) :named _xkassert8))



; ----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Rectangle:
; ----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Rectangle Rectangle)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Rectangle.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Point (Rectangle!topLeft this))
)

(assert (! (Rectangle.inv1 2) :named _xkassert9))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Rectangle.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Point (Rectangle!bottomRight this))
)

(assert (! (Rectangle.inv2 2) :named _xkassert10))



; ---------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TestNestedCtor:
; ---------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-TestNestedCtor TestNestedCtor)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TestNestedCtor.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Rectangle (TestNestedCtor!r this))
)

(assert (! (TestNestedCtor.inv1 1) :named _xkassert11))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TestNestedCtor.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Point.x (Rectangle.topLeft (TestNestedCtor!r this))) 0)
)

(assert (! (TestNestedCtor.inv2 1) :named _xkassert12))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TestNestedCtor.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Point.y (Rectangle.topLeft (TestNestedCtor!r this))) 0)
)

(assert (! (TestNestedCtor.inv3 1) :named _xkassert13))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TestNestedCtor.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Point.x (Rectangle.bottomRight (TestNestedCtor!r this))) 100)
)

(assert (! (TestNestedCtor.inv4 1) :named _xkassert14))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TestNestedCtor.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Point.y (Rectangle.bottomRight (TestNestedCtor!r this))) 50)
)

(assert (! (TestNestedCtor.inv5 1) :named _xkassert15))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        3 (lift-Point const-3-Point))
        4 (lift-Point const-4-Point))
        5 (lift-Point const-5-Point))
        6 (lift-TestUserDefinedCtor const-6-TestUserDefinedCtor))
        7 (lift-TestSeqCtor const-7-TestSeqCtor))
        2 (lift-Rectangle const-2-Rectangle))
        1 (lift-TestNestedCtor const-1-TestNestedCtor))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-6-TestUserDefinedCtor () TestUserDefinedCtor
  (mk-TestUserDefinedCtor 5))
(define-fun const-3-Point () Point
  (mk-Point 100 50))
(define-fun const-4-Point () Point
  (mk-Point 0 0))
(define-fun const__2 () Int
  20)
(define-fun const-7-TestSeqCtor () TestSeqCtor
  (mk-TestSeqCtor (seq.++ (seq.unit 1) (seq.unit 2) (seq.unit 3))))
(define-fun const-5-Point () Point
  (mk-Point 10 20))
(define-fun const__1 () Int
  10)
(define-fun const-1-TestNestedCtor () TestNestedCtor
  (mk-TestNestedCtor 2))
(define-fun const-2-Rectangle () Rectangle
  (mk-Rectangle 4 3))
(define-fun _xkassert13 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (r (sel-TestNestedCtor (select heap 1))))))
(let ((a!2 (sel-Point (select heap (topLeft (sel-Rectangle a!1))))))
  (= (y a!2) 0))))
(define-fun _xkassert14 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (r (sel-TestNestedCtor (select heap 1))))))
(let ((a!2 (sel-Point (select heap (bottomRight (sel-Rectangle a!1))))))
  (= (x a!2) 100))))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (seq.nth (s (sel-TestSeqCtor (select heap 7))) 0)))
  (= a!1 1)))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (seq.nth (s (sel-TestSeqCtor (select heap 7))) 1)))
  (= a!1 2)))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (p (sel-TestUserDefinedCtor (select heap 6))))))
  (= (x (sel-Point a!1)) 10)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (seq.len (s (sel-TestSeqCtor (select heap 7))))))
  (= a!1 3)))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (topLeft (sel-Rectangle (select heap 2))))))
  (is-lift-Point a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (p (sel-TestUserDefinedCtor (select heap 6))))))
  (= a!1 (lift-Point (mk-Point const__1 const__2)))))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (seq.nth (s (sel-TestSeqCtor (select heap 7))) 2)))
  (= a!1 3)))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (bottomRight (sel-Rectangle (select heap 2))))))
  (is-lift-Point a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert12 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (r (sel-TestNestedCtor (select heap 1))))))
(let ((a!2 (sel-Point (select heap (topLeft (sel-Rectangle a!1))))))
  (= (x a!2) 0))))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (p (sel-TestUserDefinedCtor (select heap 6))))))
  (= (y (sel-Point a!1)) 20)))
(define-fun _xkassert11 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (r (sel-TestNestedCtor (select heap 1))))))
  (is-lift-Rectangle a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert15 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (r (sel-TestNestedCtor (select heap 1))))))
(let ((a!2 (sel-Point (select heap (bottomRight (sel-Rectangle a!1))))))
  (= (y a!2) 50))))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (p (sel-TestUserDefinedCtor (select heap 6))))))
  (is-lift-Point a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (= (s (sel-TestSeqCtor (select heap 7)))
   (seq.++ (seq.unit 1) (seq.unit 2) (seq.unit 3))))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         3
                         (lift-Point (mk-Point 100 50)))
                  4
                  (lift-Point (mk-Point 0 0))))
      (a!3 (lift-TestSeqCtor (mk-TestSeqCtor (seq.++ (seq.unit 1)
                                                     (seq.unit 2)
                                                     (seq.unit 3))))))
(let ((a!2 (store (store a!1 5 (lift-Point (mk-Point 10 20)))
                  6
                  (lift-TestUserDefinedCtor (mk-TestUserDefinedCtor 5)))))
  (store (store (store a!2 7 a!3) 2 (lift-Rectangle (mk-Rectangle 4 3)))
         1
         (lift-TestNestedCtor (mk-TestNestedCtor 2))))))
